workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE border color, lineweight and visibility overrides

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

fields.borderColorOverrides: 18-bit mask; selected entries are CMC colors
fields.borderLineweightOverrides: 18-bit mask; selected entries are BS lineweights
fields.borderVisibilityOverrides: 18-bit mask; selected entries are BS visibility values

authority.ordering: Title, header and data row groups; each group follows the six documented border positions.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table retains each of the three 18-bit masks, selected CMCs, lineweights and visibility values. Separate presence arrays preserve selected zero lineweight/visibility values. Visibility outside 0/1 keeps the record semantically incomplete. The DXF writer refuses all selected border masks and orphaned retained values after mask clearing.
implementation.generatedControl: From-scratch AC1021 TABLE selects border color positions 0/17, lineweight positions 1/16 and visibility positions 2/15, verifies exact masks/values/presence, and checks the following sentinel.
implementation.outputControl: ASCII/Binary tests verify refusal with selected masks, then refusal after masks are cleared while zero-valued border metadata remains; destination preservation and corrected same-adapter retry/readback pass.

limits: Generated codec evidence only; no physical producer, whole-drawing or consumer qualification.
CMC test values are ByLayer; other color methods and color-book semantics are not qualified by this control.
DXF border precedence/mapping and native TABLE border rendering remain unqualified.
Row style and border values remain output-ineligible.
next: Establish lossless DXF mappings and precedence for retained row and border overrides before permitting output; continue only against an eligible physical source or standards-backed mapping.
